analysis.title: Rivian Automotive Inc. (RIVN): 3Q26 First Take
key_insights: Goldman calls Rivian's 3Q26 a solid report. Revenue of $2,155 mn was above the Street (FactSet) at $2,001 mn and GS at $2,082 mn, and was above the Street even excluding regulatory credits.
Adjusted EBITDA (ex. SBC) was -$435 mn versus GS at -$666 mn and the Street at -$586 mn. Adjusted EPS ex. SBC was -$0.48 versus GS at -$0.73 and the Street at -$0.64.

GAAP gross profit was $176 mn versus GS at -$95 mn. A key driver was $81 mn of regulatory credit revenue (GS assumed $0). The company also noted an unspecified benefit from an IEEPA tariff refund receivable in the quarter.

Rivian raised the low end of its 2026 deliveries guidance to 67.0K-70.0K from 65.0K-70.0K. The midpoint of 68.5K compares to GS at 67.3K and Visible Alpha at 67.1K. Implied 4Q26 deliveries are 26.7K at the midpoint versus GS at 25.4K and Visible Alpha at 25.5K.

2026 adjusted EBITDA (ex. SBC) guidance improved to -$1,850 mn to -$1,750 mn from -$2,000 mn to -$1,800 mn, about $100 mn better at the midpoint. The driver was higher regulatory credit revenue, the IEEPA tariff refund receivable in 3Q and higher expected delivery volumes.
Implied 4Q26 adjusted EBITDA guidance is -$514 mn at the midpoint, weaker than GS at -$376 mn and the Street at -$446 mn.
2026 capex guidance was cut to $1,400-$1,500 mn from $1,700-$1,800 mn. The company attributes the cut to timing of spend.

3Q26 FCF was -$1,124 mn and capex was $366 mn. Rivian ended the quarter with $5.5 bn of cash and investments and $7.1 bn of total liquidity, or $13 bn including available liquidity and targeted future capital (DOE loan and potential Uber and VW investments).
R2 outsold both R1 and EDV in the quarter, and Rivian started a second R2 production shift. 3Q deliveries were 19,248 (+57.8% QoQ, +45.8% YoY).
On autonomy, Rivian will roll out its point-to-point Autonomy Early Access Program to select users later this year, with general availability to all Autonomy+ subscribers in 2027.
GS says demand trends and margins into 2027, the technology roadmap and the VW and Uber relationships will be key for how the stock trades.
GS keeps a Neutral rating and a $16 12-month price target, based on 1.75x applied to its Q5-Q8 revenue estimate. The stock closed at $11.67 on 28 Oct 2026, implying 37.1% upside to the target.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue and adjusted EBITDA beat the Street and 2026 EBITDA guidance improved by about $100 mn at the midpoint. GS stays Neutral with a $16 target and says 2027 demand and margin commentary will drive the stock.

earnings_insights: RIVN 3Q26 reported revenue $2,155 mn vs GS est $2,082 mn and FactSet consensus $2,001 mn (+38.3% YoY, +30.0% QoQ).
RIVN 3Q26 reported GAAP gross profit $176 mn vs GS est -$95 mn, including $81 mn of regulatory credit revenue (GS assumed $0) and an unspecified IEEPA tariff refund receivable benefit.
RIVN 3Q26 reported adjusted EBITDA (ex. SBC) -$435 mn vs GS est -$666 mn and FactSet consensus -$586 mn.
RIVN 3Q26 reported adjusted EPS ex. SBC -$0.48 vs GS est -$0.73 and FactSet consensus -$0.64. GS estimates EPS including SBC at -$0.62 vs GS est -$0.89.
RIVN 3Q26 reported automotive revenue ex. regulatory credits $1,469 mn vs GS est $1,432 mn. Software, services and other revenue ex. regulatory credits was $605 mn vs GS est $650 mn.
RIVN 3Q26 reported deliveries were 19,248 (+57.8% QoQ, +45.8% YoY). Reported 3Q FCF was -$1,124 mn and capex $366 mn.

RIVN 2026 guidance (company, issued 10/29): deliveries 67.0K-70.0K (prior 65.0K-70.0K), adjusted EBITDA ex. SBC -$1,850 mn to -$1,750 mn (prior -$2,000 mn to -$1,800 mn), capex $1,400-$1,500 mn (prior $1,700-$1,800 mn). Midpoints compare to GS estimates of 67.3K deliveries and -$1,893 mn EBITDA, and Street estimates of 67.1K (Visible Alpha) and -$1,887 mn (FactSet).
RIVN implied 4Q26 guidance at midpoint: deliveries 26.7K vs GS est 25.4K and Visible Alpha 25.5K. Adjusted EBITDA is -$514 mn vs GS est -$376 mn and Street est -$446 mn.
risk_factors: Rivian's high degree of vertical integration
